nodes.name: 未配信の開発通知を取得

parameters.query:
SELECT
  o.id,o.event_type,o.project_key,COALESCE(o.task_code,'') task_code,
  CAST(o.created_at AS CHAR) created_jst,
  COALESCE(CAST(u.id AS CHAR),CAST(ur.id AS CHAR),CAST(ut.id AS CHAR),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.taskNumber')),'') task_number,
  COALESCE(u.title,ur.title,ut.title,JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.taskTitle')),'') task_title,
  COALESCE(u.status,ur.status,ut.status,'') task_status,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.promptState')),'') prompt_state,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.runId')),CAST(r.id AS CHAR),'') run_ref,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.reason')),'') reason,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.commit')),'') commit_hash,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.message')),'') payload_message,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.recommendedAction')),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.recommended_action')),'') recommended_action,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.approvalAction')),JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.operation')),'') approval_action,
  COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.impact')),'') impact,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_dispatcher_outbox p
    WHERE p.id<o.id AND p.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND p.event_type=o.event_type
      AND BINARY COALESCE(p.task_code,'')=BINARY COALESCE(o.task_code,'')
      AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.payload_json,'$.reason')),'')=COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.reason')),'')
      AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.payload_json,'$.runId')),'')=COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.runId')),'')
      AND p.created_at>=o.created_at-INTERVAL 6 HOUR) prior_same
FROM task_dispatcher_outbox o
LEFT JOIN user_tasks u ON u.owner_key='kuhara_hisashi' AND BINARY u.task_code=BINARY o.task_code
LEFT JOIN claude_development_runs r ON u.id IS NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.git_before,'$.worktree.branch'))=CONCAT('trusted-lane/',o.project_key,'/',o.task_code)
LEFT JOIN user_tasks ur ON ur.owner_key='kuhara_hisashi' AND BINARY ur.task_code=BINARY r.task
LEFT JOIN user_tasks ut ON ut.owner_key='kuhara_hisashi' AND ut.id=CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.payload_json,'$.taskId')) AS UNSIGNED)
WHERE o.delivered_at IS NULL AND o.id>=69
ORDER BY o.id ASC LIMIT 200;
